caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with four horizontal slats forming the backrest. The chair has high, rounded back posts that extend above the top slat and end in finials. There are arms on both sides of the chair, each supported by an upright vertical post and curved horizontal rest. The seat is woven with a pattern that appears blue and white or grey in color. The legs and stretchers of the chair are turned wood, and the chair sits on two curved rockers. The overall color of the wood is a warm amber or brown tone. The background is plain and a light beige color, and beneath the chair is the text "Four Slat Sister's Armed Rocking Chair" written in a simple font.
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
